newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends at 10-month low.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends at 10-month low.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed at a 10-month low against its U.S. counterpart on Tuesday amid foreign fund outflows and importer activity, dealers said.
The local unit ended at T$27.736 against Monday's T$27.720 close. The end was the lowest since T$27.746 on June 11, 1996.
Turnover through dealers was a heavy US$316.5 million.
"Foreign funds took profits from the stock market and flowed out partly due to concerns over Taiwan's worsening social disorder," said one dealer.
Importers also reported strong U.S. dollar demand on Tuesday to pay for their imports, the dealer said.
